name: RMIT Career Success WIL Grant
summary: A $1,000 grant for low-SES or Indigenous RMIT bachelor students in hardship doing a work placement of two weeks or more.
who: Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, or from a low socioeconomic background.
Bachelor student with a confirmed 2026 placement of at least two weeks ending by 30 November 2026.
Financial hardship, such as lost income or a low-income Centrelink payment or Health Care Card.
how: Complete the online application form with supporting documents.
catches: Applications may close at any time.

evidence.quote: The value of the Career Success WIL Grant is $1,000, paid after the completion of the WIL placement.
